post.summary: Take the default branch's sensitivity tags
post.description:
Give a branch forked before the default branch tagged an Attribute the tags it lacks.

One schema change adds, to every Attribute the branch shares with the default branch, the
tags the default branch gives it, and to derived Attributes the tags of what they read;
no tag is removed. It recomputes the titles and search vectors of the Kinds it changes,
so verification no longer reports them as `sensitivity_stale`. A branch that already has
the tags gives `no_op`. Protected branches refuse the change (409) unless `rows_only`:
then only a `store.sensitivity_refresh` job is queued, which rewrites those rows in
batches and leaves the schema as it is. `tags` lists the tags added only to callers
who may read the default branch's schema (empty otherwise).

query_vector.title: Query Vector
query_vector.description: Query embedding of the configured model and dimension.

tuning.description: Ranking knobs in place of the `search` settings.

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description: Full-text, vector or hybrid search (design 8.4). Vectors come from the caller.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Revision the response was served from (hex).

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.description: Typo corrections applied to q; hits found only through them come after the others.

truncated_candidates.title: Truncated Candidates
truncated_candidates.description: Only a sample of the matches of q (the first ones in index order) was ranked, as happens when every term of q is very common: better matches may exist. Add a rarer term, a Kind or a filter to narrow q.

semantic_truncated.title: Semantic Truncated
semantic_truncated.description: The vector list is shorter than asked for because the index scan reached its bound (search.semantic.max_scan_tuples, or the over-fetched nearest rows) while more Records match the filters: narrow the Kinds or the filter, or raise the bound.

SearchTuning.title: SearchTuning
SearchTuning.description:
Ranking knobs of one search in place of the `search` settings (to compare parameter
sets). Unset knobs keep their configured value; `candidates` and `typo_candidates` may only
be lowered and `trigram_threshold` only raised.

csrf_header.title: Csrf Header
csrf_header.description: Header to send the CSRF token in on unsafe requests.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: End of the session's absolute lifetime.

idle_timeout_s.title: Idle Timeout S
idle_timeout_s.description: The session ends after this long without use.

SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo
SessionInfo.description: The browser session of the caller.

last_synced_at.title: Last Synced At
last_synced_at.description: End of its last successful run (dry runs aside); null: never.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Its last successful run is older than stale_after (or it never ran).

unseen_records.title: Unseen Records
unseen_records.description: Records it owns that no run has seen for stale_after (incremental Sources with stale_after), as of the statistics.

SourceFreshness.title: SourceFreshness
SourceFreshness.description: When a Source feeding a Kind last synchronized, and what it has not seen lately.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Revision whose schema the change set was applied to.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes mapped by an expression, by api name.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: One entry per row sent: the cell of each Attribute in `attributes`.

SourcePreviewOut.title: SourcePreviewOut
SourcePreviewOut.description: Values of the expression mappings of a candidate Source on sample rows.

yaml.title: Yaml
yaml.description: Full schema document; elements it leaves out are removed.

patch.title: Patch
patch.description: Partial document (same layout as the YAML document): each element replaces the element with the same api name, or is added.

source.title: Source
source.description: Api name of the Source in the schema the change set produces.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Sample rows: column name to value (text for CSV, native values for JSON). At most `read.source_preview_max_rows`, each with at most `read.source_preview_max_columns` columns.

at.title: At
at.description: Revision id, tag or branch name.

SourcePreviewRequest.title: SourcePreviewRequest
SourcePreviewRequest.description: A candidate schema change set, the Source to preview in it and sample rows.

name.title: Name
name.description: Api name to use instead (accepted only).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Owner Kind of an Attribute, from Kind of a Relation: an api name, or `+Name` for a Kind another suggestion proposes.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: Vocabulary suggestions: the Attribute they change.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value aliases: the stored value the alias stands for.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels as the documents wrote them; the missed phrases of a vocabulary suggestion.

support.title: Support
support.description: Observations, over every document; misses for a vocabulary suggestion.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Documents it was observed in; 0 for a vocabulary suggestion, which comes from resolution misses rather than documents.

type_guess.description: For Attributes: the type the samples suggest.

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: Evidence: document, chunk, offsets into the parsed text, quote; for a vocabulary suggestion the missed phrase, its misses, distinct callers and the similarity that linked it.

duplicate_of.description: The element of the current schema it duplicates.

withheld.title: Withheld
withheld.description: Examples and samples are left out: it matches a sensitive Attribute the caller may not read.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Id of the queued (or already pending) job.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Compute and record the delta without writing to any branch.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Api name of the Kind or Relation.

TagChangeOut.title: TagChangeOut
TagChangeOut.description: Sensitivity tags added to one Attribute.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Revision id to tag.

TagCreate.title: TagCreate
TagCreate.description: A new tag at a Revision or at the head of a branch.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: More refs were touched than kept or than visible.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: Proposals the session opened or acted on.

inferred.title: Inferred
inferred.description: Grouped heuristically: the calls carried no session id and were grouped by principal and client while they kept coming (keeper.trace.inferred_session_idle_s).

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: Response cache: hit, miss or bypass.

query.title: Query
query.description: The query as sent; filter values kept only on fields that are not sensitive (keeper.trace.capture_filter_values).

result.title: Result
result.description: Counts, search mode and corrections, budget; no values.

note.title: Note
note.description: Text of a note; opaque, not markup.

trace_id.title: Trace Id
trace_id.description: W3C trace id of the request.

inferred.title: Inferred
inferred.description: The step had no session id; its session was inferred.

withheld.title: Withheld
withheld.description: Another principal's step whose query, corrections and note text the reader may not see (it lacks Domain-wide data.read or a sensitivity clearance).

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: The session has more visible steps than returned.

at.title: At
at.description: Revision id or tag to read at (time travel): key-ordered listings read the tree, other reads a snapshot of the Revision.

TraverseRequest.title: TraverseRequest
TraverseRequest.description: Follow a path of Relations from one Record (design 8.3).

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Revision the response was served from (hex).

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: Forward or inverse Relation api name.

type.title: Type
type.description: Attribute type inferred from the samples, e.g. `date`.

clearances.title: Clearances
clearances.description: The new clearances, replacing the current ones. Each one added needs the matching clearance permission on the Domain; removing needs only domain.settings.

ValidationProblem.title: ValidationProblem
ValidationProblem.description: Problem details of a rejected request body, query or path.

ValueChange.title: ValueChange
ValueChange.description: One changed Attribute (Records, Links) or property (schema elements).

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Revision of the last change.

proposal.description: The Proposal merged in that Revision, or whose conflict resolution set the value.

ValueLineageOut.title: ValueLineageOut
ValueLineageOut.description: Where the current value of one Attribute came from.

key_id.title: Key Id
key_id.description: Encryption key new values are sealed under.

token_key_id.title: Token Key Id
token_key_id.description: Token key new tokens and fingerprints use.

fingerprint_key.title: Fingerprint Key
fingerprint_key.description: Current fingerprint key: token key id/scheme.

encryption_keys.title: Encryption Keys
encryption_keys.description: Live rows by encryption key id.

fingerprint_keys.title: Fingerprint Keys
fingerprint_keys.description: Live rows by fingerprint key (`legacy`: written before rotation).

tombstone_keys.title: Tombstone Keys
tombstone_keys.description: Fingerprints of erased values by fingerprint key.

outdated.title: Outdated
outdated.description: Live rows the rotation job still has to make again.

removable_keys.title: Removable Keys
removable_keys.description: Ids in vault.previous_keys that no row uses: they can be removed.

removable_token_keys.title: Removable Token Keys
removable_token_keys.description: Ids in vault.previous_token_keys that no row or tombstone uses.

digests.title: Digests
digests.description: Key of the keyed digests: vault.digest_key, vault.token_key or installation (the database's own secret).

VaultKeysOut.title: VaultKeysOut
VaultKeysOut.description: Which keys the vault rows use.

ViaCondition.title: ViaCondition
ViaCondition.description: A Link of `via` exists, to a Record matching `where` when given.

sampled.title: Sampled
sampled.description: Only a subset of the Kind's Records was re-validated.

invalid_records.title: Invalid Records
invalid_records.description: Re-validated Records with at least one issue.

ViolationReport.title: ViolationReport
ViolationReport.description: Result of re-validating Records with the schema of the branch head.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Signing secret. Requests carry `t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>` computed over `<t>.<body>` with the key SHA-256(secret).

WebhookCreated.title: WebhookCreated
WebhookCreated.description: A new webhook; `secret` is shown this once.

quota.description: Daily quotas of the API key; null for users and without quotas.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: Merge policy options differing from defaults.

steward_roles.title: Steward Roles
steward_roles.description: Roles that look after the Kinds the changes touch (design 10.7).

assignees.title: Assignees
assignees.description: Principals who can review it as stewards (callers with principal.read only; at most keeper.stewards.max_assignees_listed).

yaml.title: Yaml
yaml.description: The proposed schema as a YAML document.

HTTPBearer.description: API key (lbk_...) or OIDC access token.
